params.text: The Keep of Echoes. Wake the altar.

hasItem.name: Player has item
hasItem.description: True when the player carries the item

actions.text: Wind howls through the Keep of Echoes. The great hall lies east.
The altar wakes with a sound like distant bells. A trapdoor opens in the hall floor, and something stirs in the shadows.

else.text: The altar is cold. It wants the Tome of Echoes, and the key.
The vault door is shut. Use it to open it.

actions.text: The air grows colder as you step into the hall.
A dart whistles past your ear!
You climb into the hall, crown in hand. The echoes fall silent. You win!
Inside lies an iron key. As you lift it, a faded mural appears on the wall.
You tumble into a lightless oubliette.
A cold wind carries you... back to the entrance.
Chains rattle. The portcullis to the south rises.
...and the floor lifts you back up into the hall.
You land among rusted spikes. Somewhere a mechanism groans...
The Crown of Echoes! Climb the ladder to leave the keep.

else.text: It's too dark to find the latch.

actions.text: You take the Tome of Echoes. The floor near the east shelves looks hollow.
A bookcase in the south wall swings aside.
The iron key turns. The vault door is unlocked.

else.text: Locked. There must be a key somewhere.

actions.text: Through a narrow window you see the sea, grey under the moon.
